name: Developmental and Stem Cell Biology PhD admitting program
detailsNote: This is a separately selectable PhD admitting/certificate program; students ultimately earn the PhD through an affiliated degree department. Department affiliation timing differs between central and program pages; confirm with DSCB.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: Graduate School current Fall2027 table controls discrepancies; exact published time11:59:59pm Eastern Standard Time.

english.toefl: 5 for exams on/afterJanuary21,2026;90 for earlier exams
english.note: Graduate School guidelines generally sought, not absolute cutoffs. IELTS Academic; DET report must include subscores. Fall2027 reports must be datedAugust1,2024 or later. A test waiver requires2years full-time English-only study in a country whose primary spoken language is English, completed before program start.

applicationFee.note: Central waivers require US citizenship/permanent residency plus eligibility conditions. Departmental limited waivers for other applicants may be available; confirm program availability before payment.

requirements.note: Undergraduate GPA calculated on a4.0scale required. Current Graduate School program table controls over older departmental pages. No writing sample required. Optional2-minute video essay is listed by the Graduate School.

funding.note: All admitted students regardless of citizenship receive tuition,fees,healthinsurance and monthly stipend for5–6years; NIH-based funding limits positions for non-US-citizen/non-permanent-resident applicants. Program funds first year; adviser supports students not on training grant.
